sourcePolicy: Only exact stable question identities already present in canonical banks are mapped. Keys are derived from choiceIds with only the trailing :choice:N suffix removed. Part 7 cross-document mappings require an internally reviewed unit, at least two distinct declared sourceLabels, and a matching source quote for each label. No content, answer key, or choice ID is generated or rewritten. Part 4 inference/action mappings require a non-reserve source, exact audio-segment quote, declared inference type and rationale. Part 6 discourse-purpose mappings require an internal-editorial-reviewed resource, exact passage quote, declared discourse function and canonical correct choice.
runtimePolicy: Evidence is collected only after a completed learner response. Mapping counts are inventory coverage, not learner mastery. Every criterion retains its own minimum unique-item count and threshold. Editorial gates continue to override practice status.
